title: Family Sitting Outdoors, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-20th century candid outdoor snapshot depicting a family group seated on a low masonry wall bordering a brick patio. On the left is a young woman wearing a striped summer dress, in the center is a matronly woman with glasses in a patterned dress, and on the right is a boy in a white crew-neck shirt and dark trousers. Potted plants and foliage decorate the background.
